How this works

Each question is answered from Strongly disagree to Strongly agree. Each answer becomes a number from 0 to 100, and each condition's score is the average across its questions and your team. Higher is always better.

Your team's results only appear once at least five team members have answered. That way nobody's answers can be picked out. Your own answers do not count toward the five.

Results wait until the round closes, so nobody can watch the numbers move as each person answers and work out who said what.

Each round asks the same ideas in slightly different words, in a different order, so people answer what they see today rather than from memory. Scores stay comparable from round to round.

An early read means fewer than 8 team members answered. Treat it as a first look. A solid read has 8 or more.
